title: Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death
abstract: arXiv:2611.27889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks have parameter symmetries: parameter transformations that do not affect the represented function. How do these symmetries affect the functions that neural networks ultimately learn? We study the implicit bias arising from these symmetries by calculating the equilibrium distribution over represented functions under Langevin dynamics with Gaussian regularization. To isolate the effect of symmetries on this distribution, we study the limit in which the strength of the regularization is taken to zero. In certain cases, we show that the zero-regularization and infinite-time limits commute. In the low temperature limit, we recover known effective regularizations. At positive temperature, a renormalization procedure allows us to derive a novel entropy which predicts symmetry-induced preference for certain functions. translated_title: 由对称性产生的重整化熵：简单性偏差与神经热寂
translated_abstract: 神经网络具有参数对称性，即不影响网络所表示函数的参数变换。这些对称性如何影响神经网络最终学习到的函数？我们通过在带有高斯正则化的朗之万动力学下计算所表示函数的平衡分布，来研究由这些对称性引起的隐式偏差。为了分离对称性对该分布的影响，我们研究了正则化强度趋于零的极限。在某些情况下，我们证明了零正则化极限与无限时间极限是可交换的。在低温极限下，我们恢复了已知的有效正则化结果。在正温度下，一种重整化方法使我们能够推导出一种新的熵，该熵可预测由对称性引起的对某些函数的偏好。对于线性网络，我们得到了显式的熵项，这些熵项有利于奇异函数和低秩函数。对于具有……的网络（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对朗之万动力学平衡分布的重整化分析，提出了一种由参数对称性诱导的新型熵，解释了神经网络隐式偏好简单函数（如低秩、奇异函数）的机制。
en_tdlr: The paper derives a novel renormalized entropy induced by parameter symmetries, explaining the implicit simplicity bias of neural networks toward singular and low-rank functions.
